text: grenke is the brand of grenke AG, an SDAX-listed company. Its major shareholder, Grenke Beteiligung GmbH & Co. KG, owned by Anneliese Grenke, company founder Wolfgang Grenke and their three sons, held 40.84 percent of the shares at 31 December 2024; the GRENKE Foundation held 3.03 percent and grenke AG 4.98 percent of its own shares. The other shareholders above 3 percent were ACATIS Investment Kapitalverwaltungsgesellschaft mbH (5.02 percent), GANÉ Investment AG (3.04 percent) and Universal Investment Gesellschaft mbH (5.03 percent). The free float was 59.16 percent.
short: grenke AG is SDAX-listed; the founding family's holding company has 40.84%, free float 59.16%.

source.name: grenke AG: Annual Report 2024 - To our shareholders
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024, Grenke Beteiligung GmbH & Co. KG held 40.84 percent of the Company’s shares, while the GRENKE Foundation owned 3.03 percent.
